missions.title: Safe Return

rebuilt.world: Replaced 11 parallel lane ridges + straight river with a capped ravine net: north wall, two northern massifs, south rim and seven meandering spurs (123 short ridge segments, ~230 wedges), every crest capped 90 studs under each jammer and 160 under the U-2 corridor; meandering eastern N-S river that bends west under the spawn (wiki: junk boat behind/below spawn) with six non-solid junk boats; dark camouflage ground colours (Shotgunnova).
rebuilt.placement: 100 jammers placed from a transcription of Mitoro's Ace detail map (x/z from labelled pixels, altitude 0.36 studs/m) deterministically decimated from the column-ordered 157; frigate at the map's labelled ship pixel on the river; update fighters north-east.
rebuilt.logic: U-2 (protected, phase 1) now follows an authored low route from the north edge through the ravine to beyond the south line (runtime path branch). f15e/ef2000 moved to recon-escort site. Counts/timers/score unchanged; balloons stay 100 provisional.

missions.sourceBasis: Wiki (7:00/1300, 15:00 update, 2+2 fighters, hidden frigate on eastern N-S river, radar lock denied); Shotgunnova Normal (U-2 from north, dense middle-right, fog, update toward eastern canyon); Mitoro Ace detail map (positions/altitudes, respawn unknown).
uncertainty: 100 vs 115 Normal jammer count unresolved; 157 is Ace only.
Normal jammer positions are not published; subset is an adaptation of Ace positions.
Pixel transcription by eye; a few overlapping labels may be misread.
Ridge relief is inferred, not surveyed.
Mitoro says frigate/destroyer points are excluded from final score; this build counts them (divergence recorded in note).
Jammer respawn not implemented (condition unknown).
missions.logicWorldStory: Briefing says find balloons visually and keep the ravine route clear: jammers now sit in the ravine at source altitudes with terrain guaranteed below them; the U-2 visibly transits the cleared route during the update; the jamCleared radio line coincides with balloons retiring.
remaining: Native fog readability of dark jammer pods against dark ridges at 0.36 studs/m altitudes.
Decide 100/115 when a Normal source appears.
tests: Safe Return spec case (belt bounds, middle-right density, >40 tall wedges survive caps, U-2 corridor clearance, path endpoints, eastern frigate, spawn clearance)

missions.title: Breaking Arrows

rebuilt.world: Removed farm hill rows and highway; low snow glacier sheet with a black basalt eastern margin (Shotgunnova 'glacier ... black part'), outer nunatak/basalt ranges capped to <=180 studs over the whole missile lane band x -1400..2100, defended landing beach + sea south of the return line with non-solid landing ships and supply tents, 25 low-lane air samples.
rebuilt.placement: Spawn moved to (-900,800,-1700) south of wave 1 (Mitoro route: approach wave 1 head-on from the south); wave 1 near the start, wave 2 and final at the north edge, XB-70 at the north-west.
rebuilt.logic: Wave 2 now triggers on afterKills 3 of wave 1 (wiki 'some'; was full clearance) - explicit provisional. Final missile requires all 15 earlier kills (wiki). F-22 escorts require 15 kills and 20 s after wave-2 clearance (Mitoro delay; adapted). XB-70 gets a fixed northern west-to-east path; points 200 kept with an explicit conflict label. Missile escape still fails the mission at the return line (unchanged runtime).

missions.sourceBasis: Wiki (20:00, wave sizes, 'some' kills, split into two fives, final after all earlier, two F-22, XB-70 120 table vs 200 prose, S 2020); Shotgunnova Normal (glacier black eastern edge, SW/SE split, S = all + escorts + XB-70 = 2020); Mitoro Ace (XB-70 northern line and north flight; F-22 delayed).
uncertainty: Exact wave-2 kill threshold unknown (3 is adaptation).
XB-70 north-flight after wave 2 not implemented.

Glacier/coast geography adapted; landing zone direction inferred from the south return line.
missions.logicWorldStory: Briefing's 'separate groups and changing approach directions' and the missile-wave-2/missile-final radio events now fire on source-shaped triggers; the defended beach behind the line makes 'one missile through ends the operation' legible.
remaining: Native check that low missiles read against snow and that 45-stud/s missiles remain catchable.
tests: Breaking Arrows spec case (lane clearance grid, wave-1 near spawn, north starts, XB-70 north, beach water, steer helper bounds)

missions.title: Emancipation

rebuilt.world: Replaced two identical 9x6 box grids and N-S runway with: New City government high-rise complex (rotated grid, 330-stud core falling off, lit glass, crowns, plaza, domed government hall), Old Towne dense low brick fabric cut by Route 7 with warm windows and an arch monument on a roundabout, sparse suburb, lit highways (Route 7, central avenue, airport boulevard, coast road), E-W San Profetta runway with centre lights, apron, terminal, tower and hangars, and a carved west coast. All buildings respect target keep-outs and Ka-50 hover slots.
rebuilt.placement: Triangle from Mitoro's labelled map (13 studs/px): New City SW, airport N, Old Towne E, start S, return line z 2000 (FAQ: map ~4/7 size). C-17 row on the apron, one SAM in the airport centre, AA rings per district, infantry in New City streets, tank pairs along Route 7, launchers 2 on the west coast + 2 NE, Ka-50 low between towers, Tu-160 pairs at the west border.
rebuilt.logic: EF-2000/Su-35/A-10 split into per-district initial groups plus clearance+30 s replacements preserving wiki totals 15/5/5 (Mitoro respawn, adapted like the accepted M5 staging). Tu-160 follow a west-to-east plan over New City, airport, Old Towne (Shotgunnova). Yellow retreat after four losses unchanged (runtime).

missions.title: Whiskey Corridor

Ridges are capped clear of every target.
rebuilt.placement: Five sectors from Mitoro's overview (13 studs/px): western defensive position (two minor clusters, one with tents), central line, Old Anchor Point city (E), northern line/HQ on the salt flat, artillery SE of HQ (wiki trivia). Pillboxes are the westernmost units. SR-71 at the SW corner at y 2400.
rebuilt.logic: 74 tanks split into sector groups (west 8+4, centre 16+8, anchor 12+6, north 20) with reveal-on-annihilation reinforcements (Mitoro); Tornado 2 -> 2 more on clearance + 3 elsewhere (total 7). Score 3500 / 20:00 and S 6300 unchanged; reinforcements never reduce reachable points.

missions.title: Siege of Farbanti

rebuilt.world: Replaced two rectangular land slabs, a 9x6 grid, a flooded grid, a Silver Bridge lying on dry land and a HQ slab with: north bank (armor approach), an E-W river with the scored Johnson Memorial Bridge spanning it, a city island with a dense damaged core (some towers broken), a west-coast GHQ landfill promontory with segmented berms, bunker portals and radar mast, an estuary on the east crossed by a cable-stayed Silver Bridge (deck, pylons, stays) linking the SE friendly bank, a flooded old-skyscraper district in the south-west bay, shore/sea walls, and road approaches to both bridges. No new part is named like the scored bridge; berths keep a hard keep-out.
rebuilt.placement: Compact combat box per Mitoro; north armor column on the bank road to Johnson, destroyer in the river beside the bridge (Mitoro), subs among flooded towers (Shotgunnova), battleship offshore SE, SAMs on the landfill and in the city exposed from above, AH-64 over the flooded district.
rebuilt.logic: Air formations chain on clearance (F-22/EF-2000 x2 formations then F-15 ACTIVE) preserving wiki totals 6/6/3; armor corrected 30 -> 29 so ground totals 55 including the scored bridge (wiki 55/2530 and Mitoro 55; Shotgunnova header 34 noted); 6 of the 29 tanks appear in the centre after 12 defender kills (Mitoro, adapted). V-22 at 600 s (last two minutes) and Yellow update unchanged.

missions.sourceBasis: Wiki (GHQ landfill on coast, Silver Bridge SE, flooded city S, armor from north via Johnson, V-22 last two minutes, 55/2530 ground, ships 580, Yellow 18:00); Shotgunnova Normal (compact map, two bridges, submerged district on western coast with subs/helicopters among skyscrapers); Mitoro Ace (bridge kills two tanks, destroyer near bridge, formation chain, centre reinforcements).
uncertainty: Coastline, river and estuary are arranged to satisfy the briefing, not traced.

Tanks-on-bridge destruction not modelled.
missions.logicWorldStory: The Johnson bridge target now visibly cuts the northern armor route; allied entry via Silver Bridge and the flooded district matches the briefing's 'bridges, sea level and the ruined district' and the final Yellow duel over the south ocean.
remaining: Native confirmation of bridge target visibility (existing AC04World.spec case should still pass).

missions.title: Megalith

rebuilt.world: Replaced the four-quadrant 360-stud cross with the source comb topology: low E-W exhaust duct (floor 90-350) open at both ends with two roof windows, two long high N-S arms (390-680) open both ends crossing over the duct, a shorter high central tube entered from a south forecourt and sealed by AC04CoreGate (runtime opens it at the update), the core beneath a 600-long vertical exit shaft, four deck silos over the duct, six ports on the arm roofs, portal/guide lights, laser masts and island sea walls broken at the duct mouths. 360-wide tunnels everywhere for cruise turn radius ~128.
rebuilt.placement: Generators: west arm south of the duct, duct centre beneath the tube, east arm north of the duct (Mitoro structure + route). Core at the tube's north end under the shaft. Escape (0,760,-1150) with square radius 300 covering the shaft mouth. Fifteen Yellows in three head-on five-ship formations (Mitoro start diagram).
rebuilt.logic: Secondary missiles corrected 500 -> 300 points (Shotgunnova + Mitoro; the wiki's own S-rank prose only holds with 300). Generator -> gate -> core -> escape ordering unchanged and authoritative: escaping before the core still fails (core_not_destroyed). Optional hatch (closed until core death) and overflight-proof escape tracker provided but not active.

missions.sourceBasis: Wiki (three large tunnels each with a generator, smaller central tunnel after generators, six zero-point ports, 15 Yellows x90, core 990, exit hatch, early exit fails); Shotgunnova Normal archived diagram (duct under the two N-S tunnels, locked central door, windows, missiles 300, opening silo roof); Mitoro Ace structure/route/start diagrams.
uncertainty: Wiki names west/east/north axes while the diagrams show two arms + duct; IDs generator-west/east/north are kept and mapped to west arm / east arm / northern duct.
Tunnel widths/heights are flight adaptations (source tunnels are much tighter).
Secondary-missile launch-if-ignored not implemented.
Without the hatch, a player can dive into the shaft after the update and shoot the core from above (documented deviation).
Escape square overflight above y 760 near the shaft during the update still fails the mission unless the tracker is wired.
missions.logicWorldStory: Briefing (three generator tunnels, infiltration team opens the central route, destroy the missile, climb out through the shaft) now matches the physical route: Bravo's gate line plays when the gate opens and the core line precedes the vertical exit.
remaining: Replace the existing AC04World.spec Megalith geometry case at integration (text below).
Native fly-through of every tunnel at cruise and max speed; generator line-of-sight from tunnel mouths.
tests: Megalith spec case (arms/duct/tube/shaft/window clearance by 3D sampling, gate is the only tube blocker, units not embedded, ports/silos exposed, escape square covers shaft, pull-up length, hatch variant blocks shaft, tracker overflight vs climb)

decisions.chosen: Keep M13 jammers at 100 (provisional) and place them from a decimated transcription of Mitoro's Ace map.
decisions.why: No Normal source resolves 100/115; Ace positions are the only spatial evidence and decimation preserves the source density pattern Shotgunnova describes.

decisions.chosen: Cap every ridge under jammers (90), the U-2 corridor (160) and the river instead of placing jammers above arbitrary terrain.
decisions.why: Keeps source altitudes and guarantees visual exposure without post-hoc pits.

decisions.chosen: M14 wave 2 after 3 of 5 wave-1 kills.
decisions.why: Wiki says 'some'; a majority keeps wave 1 the priority while letting waves overlap as in the source. Explicitly provisional.

decisions.chosen: XB-70 200 points with a conflict label; keep provisional flag.
decisions.why: Three statements say 200 and S 2020 is unreachable on first play with 120.

decisions.chosen: M15/M17 fighter respawns as initial groups + clearance replacements preserving Normal totals.
decisions.why: Matches qualitative source behaviour without inventing extra score.

decisions.chosen: M16 per-sector tank groups with reveal-on-annihilation reinforcements; sector budgets from Shotgunnova.
decisions.why: Gives the corridor a progression and sector identity while keeping the 74 total.

decisions.chosen: M17 armor 30 -> 29 so ground totals 55 including the scored bridge.
decisions.why: Wiki and Mitoro agree on 55 and the bridge is a scored ground target; the Shotgunnova header is inconsistent across missions.

decisions.chosen: M18 comb topology (low duct under two high arms, shorter locked central tube, vertical exit) with 360-wide tunnels.
decisions.why: Diagrams agree on the comb; source-scale widths are unflyable with Roblox cruise turn radius.
Shotgunnova, Mitoro and the wiki S-rank prose agree only with 300; S stays reachable (fixed 3690 + 7 Yellows).

decisions.chosen: Ship M18 without the hatch until the runtime opens it on core death; offer the escape tracker.
decisions.why: Never ship an unescapable fortress; ordering stays authoritative either way.

decisions.chosen: Map scale 13 studs per Mitoro map pixel for M13-M17 layouts; compact return lines for M15/M16/M17.
decisions.why: 13 studs/px reproduces the existing M14 return line exactly and keeps source proportions; FAQ notes compact M15/M17 maps.
